version: v1 — AV-TOOLKIT-001, the first card for a project that is not this repo
_why: AV-TOOLKIT-001 was listed with four of the five parts in network.json's `shape` block and no card at all. This is the fifth. It is also the first card here whose destination is another project's Pages surface rather than a page of this site, so it is the first that cannot be fixed by editing this repo — which is why the URL is printed unshortened and the decode is asserted by a gate rather than by a commit message.
_authored_at: Both faces are drawn at 87.5 x 55.88 with a viewBox origin of -0.95,-0.95, and trim is DERIVED by cropping 22 px per edge — docs/INTEGRATING.md, because 87.5 x 55.88 converted independently gives 2066x1320 and an odd 45-px difference cannot centre a 1275-px trim box.

palette._source: https://mrdirno.github.io/nested-resonance-memory-archive/av/trade.js — the toolkit's own runtime config, read on 2026-08-14. Not chosen here.

typography._why: The founder card's SVGs ask for DejaVu Sans, which is not installed on this machine — fc-match answers Verdana — so that stack renders as a substitution nobody chose. This one names fonts macOS actually ships. KNOWN LIMIT: that makes the render host-dependent in the other direction, and the honest fix is outlining the type, which is a change to every card and not this card's to make.
typography._min_ink_clearance: Every glyph sits >= 4 mm inside trim. The GT archive faces ran ink to 0.00 mm on six of their eight edges and a 2 mm frame ate the footer strip. Only the accent bar and the background are allowed to reach the bleed, which is what bleed is for.

qr._geometry: Rects, not an <image>. librsvg silently refuses an href above the SVG's own directory, so the founder card's ../assets reference renders an empty white patch under this rasteriser; and a raster code placed at a non-integer ratio is resampled to the grey module edges make_qr.swift exists to avoid. tools/qr_to_svg.py reads the generated PNG rather than re-encoding the URL, so there is still exactly one generator of this code.
qr._decode_floor_px: The narrowest capture OF THE WHOLE CARD that still decodes through tools/qrdecode (the system Vision detector), stepping down in 10 px increments. Control run in the same command on the card that actually ships today: examples/founder-card back fails at 260 px. Same 33 modules, 1 mm more code, hard vector edges.
